I stopped round 492 for a B ruling: one sentence in the new doc 318 (l.22) is false, and the task's STOP rule covers any false doc line. The code itself passed every check I ran.

**The STOP.** Doc 318 l.22 says that when the dialog opens, the Current Password field shows a focus ring. That is only true when it is opened from the keyboard. After a mouse open there is no ring:
- the task's own deviation says so, because the site-wide focus rule from SABA-B-4 hides rings after a mouse press;
- B's comparison shows 0 px difference from HEAD for a mouse-opened dialog at all three viewports.

The same sentence also says the visuals are otherwise unchanged, but the trigger now shows a ring after a keyboard close. My code-reviewer found this. B's sketch review has no ruling on it, and I may not edit sketch lines. My suggestion is a one-line grant to correct l.22; the report includes proposed wording.

**What I ran.** I applied B's sketch exactly and left the tree as is.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Start check vs B's planning output | equal |
| Patch apply | rc 0, sha matches the recorded one |
| Claims after the apply | equal to B's sketch output, checksum line `======` |
| `npm run typecheck` | rc 0 |
| `npm run lint` | rc 0; 183 warnings repo-wide, down from 187 at gate 491 (the 4 old `account.tsx` warnings are gone) |
| Biome on the owned code files | 0 diagnostics |
| Covering tests | 6 files / 97 tests pass; slowest 90 ms against the 5 s default timeout |

`git status` shows exactly the 6 granted paths. I did not run the full suite, the build, browser probes or mutants, as the task directs.

**Code-reviewer.** No Critical, High or Medium findings.
- **Already ruled by B:** two Lows and two Infos map to existing rulings.
- **New Lows, recorded as `A-R492-REVIEW-L1` … `L9` plus one Info; none fixed, all inside sketch lines:**
  - **Two for B to look at first:**
    - the Esc guard checks only `isComposing`, not `keyCode 229`, so Safari's IME-ending Esc can close the dialog;
    - one assert in test PD8 can never fail.
  - **The other seven:**
    - a repeated identical error is not announced again;
    - an error after the user dismissed the dialog during a pending submit is never shown (reachable today, because `updatePassword` always throws);
    - a mouse reopen during the fade lands on the backdrop;
    - the Tab trap's control list only covers inputs and buttons;
    - three tests are weaker than they look: PD10, PD3, and PD11/PD15, which need a browser to confirm.

**Architecture note (proposal only).** Keep the code where it is for now. Once root answers ARCH-CHECKPOINT-ACCOUNT-PROFILE, a small task could move the dialog's focus logic into a local `usePasswordDialogFocus` hook.

**Acceptance.** I marked as passed only the A-side checks in the table above. The "docs true at hand-over" criterion is not passed, and I claim no browser, mutant, full-suite or build row.

**Next for C.** C runs the short route for a stopped round: C1, C2, C8, and a check of the doc 318 l.22 sentence, then reports "STOPPED — routed to B". If B grants the l.22 fix, I apply only that line on re-dispatch, and C runs the full C1–C10 table.

The report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-492.md`, with logs in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-492/`.
